company.shortDescription: Daqstra develops software for observing, orchestrating, and analyzing physical R&D tests.
company.description: Daqstra develops software for physical research and development testing. Its platform connects test hardware, models devices and configurations, captures telemetry with calibration and provenance data, and supports execution of test sequences. The software provides centralized observability, run-data querying, anomaly analysis, hardware control, and API-based orchestration for aerospace, energy, robotics, manufacturing, and other hardware-intensive engineering programs.
